report.summary: Both UI tests fail at the same step: Playwright waits 5s for get_by_test_id("add-books") and times out, because the page has no such element. The page object in tests/support/pages.py is out of sync with the template, which renders the button as data-testid="add-book". Fix the selector in pages.py:44 first; both tests should then get past the click.

causes.title: Page object uses data-testid "add-books" but the app's button is "add-book"
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"), but app/templates/books.html defines the submit button as data-testid="add-book". The locator never matches, so Playwright times out before any behavior is exercised. Both tests call books.add() and die at that line, so the failure says nothing about adding books or the future-year validation. The app's template is the source of truth here; the test-side selector is the stale part.
evidence: Failure call log: "waiting for get_by_test_id(\"add-books\")" with Timeout 5000ms exceeded, for both tests
causes.suggested_fix: Change tests/support/pages.py:44 to get_by_test_id("add-book"). Also check that no other code references "add-books" (search found only this line). After that, rerun both tests; if the future-year test then fails on its assertions, triage that failure separately, since it is not established by this log.
